correctness.rationale: For the stated physical-time two-patch ODE, set A=1+D1, q=1-D2/A and m=aq with 0<a<q. Independent expansion gives d[(D1/A)x1+x2]/dt=x2^2(q-a-x2)/(x2+a) and the off-diagonal positive couplings make x2 eventually positive for every nonzero nonnegative initial state. A hypothetical approach to zero would make the strictly positive weighted coordinate eventually nondecreasing, contradicting its vanishing. The Jacobian J=[[-A,D2],[D1,-D1D2/A]] has eigenvalues 0, -(A+D1D2/A), right nullvector v=(D2/A,1) and left w=(D1/A,1). The second equation has quadratic coefficient (q-a)/a along v; left/right projection gives κ=((q-a)/a)/(1+D1D2/A²)=A²(q-a)/(a(A²+D1D2))>0 when x2=u+O(u²). Thus the positive center side is repelling in forward physical time. Valid only m=aq, 0<a<q; no statement for positive E3 collision or a≥q.
residual_risks: Numerical phase portrait is merely corroborative, not the source of the sign or global exclusion.
